summary: Added ControlValueAccessor support to Angular select, checkbox, radio group, and switch controls while preserving their existing input/output APIs and native accessibility semantics.

evidence.description: Select CVA, form-disabled composition, blur/touched handling, and non-emitting writeValue.
Checkbox CVA with strict boolean normalization and native input interaction.
Radio group CVA preserving required name, fieldset disabled state, invalid semantics, and reset to no selection.
Switch CVA preserving button role, keyboard-native click behavior, aria-checked, and disabled interaction guard.
Reactive Forms Storybook examples added for all four controls.
Consumer documentation for formControl/formControlName and disabled-state coexistence.

validation.command: corepack yarn install && corepack yarn workspace @code2youlabs/angular test && corepack yarn workspace @code2youlabs/angular check && corepack yarn build && corepack yarn check && git diff --check
validation.details: Angular package TestBed suite passed (5 tests) alongside 33 CLI tests; package and repository build/check passed; git diff check passed. Angular emits its standard warning about combining a disabled input binding with Reactive Forms in the test hosts.
